svg.title: 3x3 grid with a soft mid-gray bordered selected photo over a nested 6x6 of near-black tones
svg.desc: A 3 by 3 grid of nine square frames each filled a random shade of gray, with one larger square layered on top of the center made of a nested 6 by 6 of near-black grayscale tones, bordered in a mid gray slightly lighter than the surrounding grid line color.
